results.description:
He was supposed to execute my brother.

Instead, he offered me a ring.

Laszlo Novak is New York's most feared mafia boss. Cold. Untouchable. A man who spends his days preparing the dead for burial and his nights ruling an empire built on blood.

When my reckless brother lands on his execution list, I have only one way to save him.

Marry Laszlo for one year.

It's a business arrangement. A sacrifice. Nothing more.

Except my new husband doesn't believe in boundaries.

He watches me like I already belong to him.

He remembers things I've never told him.

And every time I try to keep my distance, he smiles as though he knows something I don't.

I thought I was marrying a stranger.

I was wrong.

Because Laszlo Novak has been waiting for me for years.

And by the time I discover the truth...

It will already be too late.

RUIN ME UNTIL I'M YOURS is a dark mafia romance featuring a morally black hero, forced marriage, obsession, possessive love, high spice, and a guaranteed HEA. Please check the content warnings before reading.
